pains.statement: On-call engineers spend most incidents manually correlating logs across systems with no unified trace.
pains.suggestedEvidence: MTTR for last sev-2; tools opened per incident.

pains.statement: Every team runs slightly different Kubernetes or VM patterns—no shared platform contract.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Count cluster flavors or golden images; time to onboard a new service.

pains.statement: Production runbooks are stale; recovery steps live in senior engineers' heads.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Last incident where runbook was wrong or missing.

pains.statement: Alert noise hides real failures—pages fire on symptoms nobody owns.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Alerts per week; ratio of false positives.

pains.statement: Terraform and manual console changes diverge; nobody trusts the state file.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Drift detections per month; last scary apply.

pains.statement: Managed service commitments block incremental platform change.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Contract constraint; smallest change rejected or priced out.

pains.statement: Batch and cron jobs overlap peak traffic windows because schedules were never revisited.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Job window vs traffic peak; what stalls.

pains.statement: Leadership wants 'platform modernization' but no fundable first SLO or golden path.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Platform roadmap slide vs funded epics this quarter.
